> I'm designing a drone flight controller from scratch. It's built around an STM32F405 microcontroller with an ICM-42688-P IMU and a DPS310 barometer, plus onboard voltage regulators so it can run directly from a 4S LiPo battery. I'll design a 4-layer PCB in KiCad in the standard 30x30mm mounting size, paying close attention to power filtering and noise around the gyro. The goal is to get it running Betaflight and fly a real quad with it. This is my most challenging PCB yet, and I want to learn mixed power/signal design, high-speed layout, and how real flight hardware works.
